name.description: Name of the chart. Converted to a valid Kubernetes name (lowercase letters, digits and `-`), so `my.app` becomes `my-app`.
name.x-prompt: Provide a name for your chart

project.description: Name of the project to add the chart to

chartFolder.description: Folder for the chart, relative to the project root. The default `chart` creates `{projectRoot}/chart`.
chartFolder.x-prompt: Provide the chart folder (relative to the project root)

format.description: Deprecated, has no effect. Files are now always formatted; use `skipFormat` to opt out.
format.x-deprecated: Files are now always formatted and the chart templates are added to .prettierignore. Use `skipFormat` to opt out.

skipFormat.description: Skip formatting files. The chart `templates` folder is added to `.prettierignore` either way.
